figma-dev-mode._comment: Figma Dev Mode MCP — requires Figma Desktop App with Dev Mode MCP Server enabled (Preferences > Dev Mode MCP Server > ON). Used for B案 (quality pipeline) design-to-code workflow.

stitch._comment: Google Stitch MCP — run 'npx @_davideast/stitch-mcp init' for first-time auth. Used for A案 (speed pipeline) design-to-code workflow.

notion._comment: Notion MCP — SOP database sync and page operations. Set NOTION_API_KEY in environment.

slack._comment: Slack MCP — channel messaging, search, and canvas operations.

github._comment: GitHub MCP — repository, PR, and issue management for falco28-caio/influencer-ops.
